sql: ALTER TABLE dingtalk_synced_nodes ADD COLUMN source VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'docs'
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_dingtalk_nodes_user_node_source ON dingtalk_synced_nodes (user_id, dingtalk_node_id, source)

DELETE FROM dingtalk_synced_nodes
        WHERE id NOT IN (
            SELECT MIN(id)
            FROM dingtalk_synced_nodes
            GROUP BY user_id, dingtalk_node_id
        )
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_dingtalk_nodes_user_node ON dingtalk_synced_nodes (user_id, dingtalk_node_id)
ALTER TABLE dingtalk_synced_nodes DROP COLUMN source
